description: The signed-in couple's own wedding registry on Zola: add 1 product of the Zola shop, in 1 color or size, with a quantity. Get the sku_id from the options of a product of zola_search_registry_products, and ask the couple to choose when the product has several options. Guests see the item on the registry at once. Status possible_duplicate: the registry has this product already, and Zola added nothing. To change its quantity, use zola_update_my_registry_product. If the couple wants a second item of it, give the match_id of each match in ignore_match_ids. A call without confirm_token changes nothing: it returns a preview with a confirm_token. Show the preview to the couple. Call again with the same arguments and the confirm_token only after the couple says yes. Requires Zola sign-in (account:write).

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token of the preview. Give it only after the couple said yes to that preview, with the same arguments

ignore_match_ids.description: The match_id of each item of a possible_duplicate preview, when the couple says that she wants a second item of the product

quantity.description: How many to ask for, as the product page counts them. 1 when the couple does not say

sku_id.description: The sku_id of 1 option (a color or a size) of a product of zola_search_registry_products

name: zola_add_my_registry_product

outputSchema.description: The preview or the result of a product added to the registry of the signed-in couple

cannot_undo.description: What the change removes and Zola cannot restore

changed.description: True only when this call changed the registry

confirm_token.description: Give it to zola_add_my_registry_product with the same arguments, only after the couple says yes

expires_at.description: The end of the validity of confirm_token, ISO 8601 UTC

links.description: The zola.com pages for this data

record_count.description: The new registry items that change

records.description: The new registry items with a change, in the order of the call

removal.description: True when the change removes or overwrites a value

id.description: The id of the record, as zola_search_my_registry_items gives it

matches.description: With possible_duplicate: the records that look like the new one

id.description: Give it in ignore_match_ids when the couple wants the new record beside this one

name.description: The record, as the couple knows it

version.description: The version of the record as this call read it

replayed.description: True when this is the stored result of an earlier call with the same confirm_token

status.description: preview: nothing changed, confirm_token makes the change. nothing_to_change: nothing to change, no confirm_token. done: changed. draft_changed: nothing changed, a new preview. record_changed: nothing changed, read again

title: Add My Registry Product
